extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single SoA table (ISA Section 1.3) on document pages 11-12 under a header reprinted on p.12; the intro text on p.11 (delta statement and pointer to the master and CLBP DSA SoAs) is captured as table-wide note g1. p.11 has a clean text layer; p.12 is glyph-spread (one token per glyph or glyph group): the PK sample and Participant returns device Notes cells and the p.12 activity labels were rebuilt from the glyph stream and checked against the rendered page (§1c). Marks verified by pdftotext -bbox column binning (no disagreement with the visual read). Cell boundaries from raster rule lines (§1d). Notes column cells captured as annotations with synthesised markers n1-n12 (two cells split by the sentences that name visits). Abbreviation list dropped (it carries one CCI box). Redaction on p.12: one full row below 'PK sample' (label, all schedule cells and its Notes cell).

table_metadata.table_purpose: ISA BP02 (LY3526318, chronic low back pain) schedule: visits and procedures unique to the ISA, on top of the master CPMP and CLBP DSA CPMP(2) SoAs; V3-V7 and ED shared with the master, no follow-up visits added
table_metadata.notes: One label column (L=1); data columns at positions 2-7 (V3 -> 2, V4 -> 3, V5 -> 4, V6 -> 5, V7 -> 6, ED -> 7); the right-hand Notes column is not a schedule column. Typed main_soa: every participant randomised into this ISA passes through it in sequence. It is a delta schedule: the intro text says it shows only what is unique to the ISA, so the participant's full schedule is this table plus the master and DSA SoAs. The taxonomy has no type for that relation; it is recorded here and in g1. Two full-width section bands ('Clinical Laboratory Tests and Sample Collection', 'Participant Device') group the rows below them. One row between 'PK sample' and the 'Participant Device' band is fully redacted (CCI); its row position (19) is left unassigned.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band: 'Randomization to ISA' (V3 only), 'Double-Blind Treatment' spanning V4-V7, 'Early Discontinuation' (ED). Typed by the value that spans several columns (a study phase) -> epoch; the single-column 'Randomization to ISA' and 'Early Discontinuation' are values of the band. The label cell is blank, so the name is synthesised.
Visit identifiers V3-V7, ED -> visit. The label cell is blank, so the name is synthesised.
Study week per visit: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8; blank for ED -> week.
Allowed deviation in days: blank for V3, one '±3' cell merged across V4-V7, blank for ED -> window; a qualifier of the columns, so hierarchical_level null.

activities.activity_name: Clinical Laboratory Tests and Sample Collection

activity_name_source.cell_text: Clinical Laboratory Tests and Sample Collection

annotations.annotation_text: This SoA shows visits and procedures unique to the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-BP02 (BP02) for LY3526318. Please refer to the CPMP Master Protocol and the CLBP DSA H0P-MC-CPMP(2) SoAs for additional information.
Symptom-directed physical exam (see Section 8.2.1) at V5, V7, and ED (if applicable).
At V3, vitals should be taken predose and at approximately 2 and 4 hours post dosing.
At V4, V5, V6, and V7, vitals should be taken predose.
Pulse rate, respiratory rate, blood pressure, and temperature taken with participant in a sitting position.
Single ECGs at V5, V7, and ED (if applicable).
For all WOCBP at V3: collect sample before dosing.
At V3, samples should be taken at 2 and 4 hours (±15 minutes) post dosing.

At V4, V5, V6, and V7, a sample for PK should be taken before the dose is administered; participants should be asked to refrain from taking their dose on V4-V7 until they have their clinic visit and after the blood sample is taken.
The date and time of LY3526318 administration prior to the PK sampling will be recorded, i.e., the dose administered in the clinic at V3 and the last at-home dose prior to each of V4, V5, V6, and V7.
If a dBM device is used, the participant will return the device to the site at V7 or ED (if applicable).

review_items.call_made: 'For all WOCBP at V3: collect sample before dosing.' is one sentence naming V3, so it is bound to the V3 cell of Urine pregnancy only. Read this way, the WOCBP restriction applies to the V3 sample only.
review_items.alternative: Split it: 'For all WOCBP' as a condition on the whole row (all six marks), and 'at V3: collect sample before dosing' on the V3 cell (the reading BP01/NP01/OA01 print as two lines).

review_items.call_made: 'The date and time of LY3526318 administration prior to the PK sampling will be recorded, i.e., the dose administered in the clinic at V3 and the last at home dose prior to each of V4, V5, V6, and V7.' is split from the PK Notes cell and bound to the PK cells V3-V7 (text_match): it says what is recorded at those visits.
review_items.alternative: Keep it on the PK row as a note on the activity: the visits are named as reference points for the dose times to be recorded, not as a condition on the visits.
